film50.say: Forty five letters. One exam tomorrow. And a word you have never seen before.
Can you say it? Can you spell it? Do you know what it means?
Breathe. MedLex has you.
Every medical word is a puzzle. Tap peri, card and itis, and pericarditis explains itself. Then build it yourself, piece by piece.
Daily sessions, illustrated guides, root cards and quick checks.
Start free today, and decode your first word in ten seconds.

film180.say: Pneumono, ultra, microscopic, silico, volcano, coni, osis. Forty five letters. A ward round in the morning. And a word you have never seen before.
Can you say it out loud? Can you spell it on a chart? And when someone asks what it means, will you know?
Breathe. Long words are just small parts, joined together. MedLex has you.

film180.title: Decode
film180.say: It starts with a puzzle. Tap peri, card and itis, and pericarditis explains itself. Every answer shows you why. Gastr means stomach. Add itis, and you have gastritis.

film180.title: Practise
film180.say: Your day is ten minutes and ten words, mixing new terms with smart reviews. Match each part to its meaning. Then flip it around, and build the word yourself.
imgs: Match the part to its meaning

film180.title: Library
film180.say: Every term in the library is taken apart, explained in plain words, and spoken aloud. Sixty six prefixes, sixty roots and a hundred suffixes, each with its own studio.

film180.title: See it
film180.say: Illustrated guides decode a term in five steps. Each body system lives on one beautiful canvas, with a hundred terms and outcomes you can tick off.

film180.title: Remember
film180.say: Root cards give you a picture and a hook. Card means heart. Hemi means half. A quick check after every card proves it stuck.

film180.title: Grow
film180.say: Travel nine eras of medical language, from ancient Egypt to Vesalius. And watch your mastery grow, one body system at a time.
Fourteen hundred and eighty terms. Twenty six modules. Fifty six illustrated guides.
MedLex is free to start. The full app comes with the Crown Pass, with seven days free. Decode your first word today.

film50.say: The hardest moment on shift is not always clinical. Sometimes, it is the next sentence you say.
What do I tell a worried family? How do I escalate this? Was my handover clear?
Breathe. Carecraft has you.
Each day, one real moment from a working shift. Think first, choose, then see feedback that names what worked, and what to try next.
Short lessons, visual guides, a handover builder and practice you can see.
One useful minute a day. Start free today.

film180.say: The hardest moment on shift is not always clinical. Sometimes, it is the next sentence you say. To a frightened family. To a busy doctor. To the colleague taking over from you.
What do I say? How do I escalate without sounding unsure? Did my handover really make sense?
Breathe. These are skills, and skills can be practised. Carecraft has you.

film180.title: Daily scenario
film180.say: Every day, one moment from a working shift. Think first, then compare your reasoning. The feedback names the behaviour, and gives you one specific thing to try next.

film180.title: Learn
film180.say: Thirty short lessons for the work you do, from foundation to advanced. Read, practise and reflect, with your own notes beside every lesson. Or learn as a guided slideshow.

film180.title: See it
film180.say: Ninety illustrated guides you can zoom, save and share. Listen with intention. Explain with clarity. Make numbers mean something.

film180.title: Practise
film180.say: An animated handover shows the message in order. Spot the hand hygiene moment in a ward scene, with no time pressure. Watch, decide, reflect.

film180.title: Toolkit
film180.say: Build a clear handover step by step, with worked examples beside you. Situation, background, assessment, recommendation. Fictional practice drafts, never clinical records.

film180.title: Grow
film180.say: See the skills you have rehearsed, from communicating to escalating to wellbeing. It shows coverage, not a competence score.
Thirty lessons. Ninety visual guides. Twenty two practice activities.
Carecraft is free to start. The full app comes with the Crown Pass, with seven days free. One useful minute a day.

film50.say: You highlighted everything. Every page is yellow. So why does so little stick?
Three hundred pages. Four days left. Where do you even start?
Breathe. Lumen has you.
Bring in your own notes. Read beside your tools. Then hide the page, explain it from memory, and check what you missed.
Recall cards, notes, focus sessions, and a reading space that is yours.
Your notes stay on your device. Start free today.

film180.say: You highlighted everything. Every page is yellow. You read it twice. So why, when the exam asks, does so little stick?
Three hundred pages. Four days left. Where do you even start?
Breathe. Reading is not remembering. Recall is. Lumen has you.

film180.title: Bring it in
film180.say: Add a PDF or photos of your own notes. Lecture notes, handouts and books live in one calm library. Everything stays private, on your device.

film180.title: Read
film180.say: Read beside your tools. Highlight, write, add sticky notes and mark a region, right on the page. A lens follows your pointer when you need to read closely.

film180.title: Explain
film180.say: Then the real learning. Hide the page. Explain it from memory. Reveal it, and compare. Think first, then reveal, with active recall and explain it back.

film180.title: Remember
film180.say: Turn a moment into a recall card. Review timing adapts to how well you knew it. Your cards and practice lab wait for you in the study studio.

film180.title: Connect
film180.say: Every highlight and note is gathered and searchable. Drag clinical stickers onto the page, and look up words with help in many languages, including Arabic.

film180.title: Focus
film180.say: Twenty five minutes, one clear goal, soft sounds and short breaks. Daylight or evening, warm pages and your text size. Make yourself comfortable.
A five step learning loop. Six study methods. Zero automatic uploads.
Lumen is free to start. The full app comes with the Crown Pass, with seven days free. Turn your own notes into recall.

film180.say: You look after everyone. All shift. Every shift. The call bell, the family, the handover. So, between tasks, who looks after you?

film180.title: Your space

film180.say: Fifteen practices. Twelve illustrated guides. Two minutes is enough. And nothing, ever, is monitored.

film180.say: You trained for years. You care for patients every day. And now, one exam stands between you and your nursing career in the Gulf Region.
Saudi, Qatar, Dubai or Abu Dhabi? Which questions will they ask? And on the day, will you really be ready?
Breathe. You already think like a safe nurse. We will help you show it. We have you.

film180.title: Four exams

film180.title: Question bank

film180.title: Mock exams

film180.title: Decision tools

lss.name: Green Belt
lss.tagline: Lean Six Sigma for healthcare practitioners.
worry: Is it the people, or the system?

end.paidLine: Full toolkit, exam and certificate, 12 months

film50.say: Every delay on your ward has a cause. The waiting room is full again.
Is it the people, or the system? And can you prove it?
Breathe. The Green Belt toolkit has you.
Map the patient journey and watch the waiting appear. Then plot the data, and see the moment your change made a real difference.
Thirty tools, simulations, a playground, exam practice and a certificate.
Free to try. Fix the cause, and prove it.

film180.say: Every delay on your ward has a cause. The waiting room is full again. Antibiotics are late again. And everyone is working as hard as they can.
Is it the people, or the system? Where does the time really go? And if you fix it, can you prove it?
Breathe. Data tells you where. Judgement tells you what to do. The Green Belt toolkit has you.

film180.title: Define
film180.say: Thirty tools follow the DMAIC path, with a live statistical engine. Start with the problem, then brainstorm causes across all six categories, before anyone is blamed.

film180.title: Measure
film180.say: Map the journey from emergency department to ward, and watch the waiting appear. Find the bottleneck first, because speeding up one step can simply flood the next.

film180.title: Analyse
film180.say: Put the biggest causes first with a Pareto chart. Test your hypothesis, and see what the numbers really say.

film180.title: Improve
film180.say: Plot your change over time. In this example, door to antibiotic time fell from eighty six to fifty four minutes, and the toolkit flags the shift for you. Safety comes from resilient systems, not perfect people.

film180.title: Control
film180.say: Control limits tell you when a spike is real. In the red bead ward, every point sits inside the limits: the differences come from the system, so stop ranking people.

film180.title: Play
film180.say: Learn Lean Six Sigma by playing it, with two game worlds, eighteen tools and twenty one levels. And trace the history, from Ford’s line in nineteen thirteen to today’s wards.

film180.title: Certify
film180.say: Practise for nine certification blueprints, then earn your Certificate of Completion, with an ID badge and a verifiable code.
Thirty tools. Ten simulations. Over a thousand exam practice items.
The Green Belt toolkit is free to try. Full access is for twelve months, paid once. Fix the cause, and prove it.

film180.say: Somebody made care better today. A safer ward. A faster diagnosis. A calmer family. It happens everywhere, every day. Did anyone write it down?
Your best work, forgotten. Your impact, unseen. Your story, untold.
Breathe. Good work deserves a record. Evinca has you.

film180.title: Come in
film180.say: Someone did the work. Someone noticed. Someone was cared for. Tell your story, nominate a colleague, thank a carer, or recognise your team. In two minutes, without an account, see which recognition your evidence fits.

film180.title: Spotlight
film180.say: Every month, a verified moment of good care. Share your Spotlight Story free, and verify it when you are ready.

film180.title: In context

film180.title: Recognition

film180.title: Proof

film180.title: Independence

film180.title: Grow

Free to share. Four levels. An eight seat editorial board. And one public record behind every honour.
Share your Spotlight Story free today. Your best work, recognised on evidence.
